testSuites.name: example-suite
testSuites.description: Template for creating new test suites

_comments.name: Unique identifier for the test suite (kebab-case)
_comments.displayName: Human-readable name shown in CLI menus
_comments.description: Brief description of what this suite tests
_comments.type: Suite type: unit, integration, e2e, security, performance, contract
_comments.workspace: npm workspace path relative to project root
_comments.command: Command to execute the tests (run from workspace directory)
_comments.requiredServices: Array of service names that must be running
_comments.dataScenario: Name of data scenario to seed before tests (null for none)
_comments.canRunParallel: Whether this suite can run in parallel with others
_comments.supportsCoverage: Whether this suite supports coverage reporting
_comments.tags: Array of tags for filtering and categorization
_comments.environment: Environment variables to set during test execution
_comments.retries: Number of times to retry failed tests (0 = no retries)
_comments.failFast: Whether to stop on first test failure
_comments.outputFormat: Default output format: console, json, junit
